I replied in your thread in #central-team: the store is **Pine Crossing**.

On 9 Jun 2026 you posted in #central-team that the Pine Crossing morning receiver's appointment screen showed only the afternoon shift. A driver had arrived at 7:10 and they wrote his trailer number on a sticky note. Hollis said he'd check the shift template and ask support to try it with the store's login.

There's no later update on it in the channel. The channel also doesn't give an address or site code for Pine Crossing, so if the account sheet needs one, you'll have to get it from store ops or the account records.
